property_origin_contract.independence_consequence: k divided by diffusivity and c_p recovers the assumed density algebraically and cannot source-lock density or volumetric heat capacity independently

required_additional_inputs: Cp-to-cv thermodynamic correction for the declared graphite regime
independently measured same-grade density with uncertainty or a direct volumetric heat-capacity source
material-regime correspondence to the declared TTG source

claim_boundary: This package source-locks one independent c_p row and its 95% confidence interval at 573.15 K. Its reported thermal conductivity is derived from diffusivity, c_p, and an assumed density, so it cannot independently source-lock density or volumetric c_v. It does not derive e0, identify Phi with Phi_E, or calibrate alpha_Phi_K.
